title: 对比反思：迭代提示优化框架
summary: 提出对比反思框架，用于代理式信息检索工作流中的迭代提示优化。通过识别错误行为、对比成功案例，由教师LLM提出针对性编辑，仅在验证性能提升时接受。在HotpotQA上，精确匹配准确率从51.4%提升至60.4%，优于MIPROv2和GEPA。
summary_en: Proposes Contrastive Reflection, an iterative prompt optimization framework for agentic IR workflows. It identifies error-anchored behavioral slices, contrasts with successful examples, and uses a Teacher LLM to propose targeted edits accepted only upon validation improvement. Achieves 60.4% exact-match accuracy on HotpotQA, outperforming MIPROv2 and GEPA.
